executive_summary: Reworkd is an AI agent platform designed to automate browser-based workflows, targeting small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Founded in 2023 by Srijan Subedi, who has a background in clinical research, the company is part of the Y Combinator Summer 2023 batch, indicating early traction and validation. With a focus on simplifying workflows for SMBs, Reworkd shows promise in a growing market for AI-driven productivity tools.
team: Srijan Subedi is the founder of Reworkd AI and has a combined major in Science from UBC. He has prior experience as a Clinical Researcher at STEMCELL Technologies and Heart Lung Innovation, suggesting a strong technical background.
product: Reworkd builds an AI agent platform that automates workflows performed in web browsers, aimed at improving efficiency for users.
market: The product targets small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) looking for automation solutions to enhance productivity. No specific competitors are mentioned in the data.
